description: This Java class defines a scheduled task for sending alert reminder emails within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It extends an abstract task class and implements logic to fetch unread alerts, determine recipients, and send message notifications.

classes.name: AlertReminderTask
classes.description: A scheduled task class responsible for sending alert reminder messages to users with unread alerts in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked to perform the task: fetches unread alerts and initiates notifications.

methods.name: sendAlertNotifications
methods.description: Creates and sends a message to all recipients of the provided alerts.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Extracts and returns a collection of users who are recipients of unread alerts.
